statement.p: Let \vec F = 6 x e^{y}\,\vec i + 3 x^2 e^{y}\,\vec j and \vec G = 6(x - y)\,\vec i + 3(x + y)\,\vec j. Let C be the path consisting of lines from (0,0) to (4,0) to (4,2) to (0,0). Find each of the following integrals exactly:

static.solution:
(a) Since \vec F = 6 x e^{y}\,\vec i + 3 x^2 e^{y}\,\vec j is a gradient vector field and C is a closed curve, \int_C \vec F\cdot d\vec r = 0.
(b) Since \frac{\partial}{\partial x}(3(x + y)) - \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(6(x - y)) = 9, by Green's Theorem,\int_C\vec G\cdot d\vec r = \int_R\left(9\right)\,dA = 9(\mbox{Area of triangle}) = 36.
